out: ship: Puts pull requests in the merge queue, one after another, as it is told them, and says how each one ended. In read mode it changes nothing, and says what it would do. In tsh it only reads: its mode takes read alone.
--mode  "read"  read: change nothing, say what the machine would send. tsh has no write mode: it never writes to GitHub.
pr=  string  A pull request to ship. Tell it any time, as many as you like: each gets a fresh run of the ship machine once the one before has ended.

ask=  {id: string, pr: string}  A pull request to ship, with the id its answer comes back under on `answer`. Asked again under an id already answered, it answers again from what it kept, and ships nothing twice.
>found  {pr, facts, outcome, name, … (6 fields)}  Read mode, once per pull request: the facts read, the machine's answer, and the write it would send next. Nothing was sent.
>outcome  {pr, outcome, name}  Write mode, once per pull request: how it ended.
>answer  {id, pr, outcome, name}  Write mode, once per ask, and again for each ask again: how its pull request ended, under the ask's id.
ship --describe <name> shows one flag, input or output whole.

review-scripted: The review program with a scripted reviewer: it reads each pull request from GitHub and runs the gate for real, then passes every criterion without reading the code. It costs nothing. It proves the wiring, not a review.
--rubrics  string  The folder the rubric texts are read from: code.md, doc.md, skill.md.
--model  string  The model the reviewer runs on.
--budget  number > 0  The dollars one reviewer run may cost before it is stopped.
pr=  string  A pull request to review. Tell it any time: each gets a fresh run of the review machine once the one before has ended.

>verdict  {pr, outcome, name, head, … (13 fields)}  Once per pull request: the outcome, each criterion met or open with what shows it, the verdict of each kind, the notes filed, and what the reviewer cost.
>passed  string  The url of each pull request that met every criterion at its head now. Not sent for a replay of an older commit. Pipe it into ship's `pr`.

>note  {pr: string, id: string, title: string, body: string, … (5 fields)}  Each note the reviewer filed while it worked: something worth fixing that this change did not cause. Kept here, posted nowhere.
review-scripted --describe <name> shows one flag, input or output whole.
>found  (output of ship)  Read mode, once per pull request: the facts read, the machine's answer, and the write it would send next. Nothing was sent.
